note:
Trial 43 ended in death. The screen reads "TRIAL END: DEATH" with the message that I was shot by a Stray.

What happened:
- The lone visible hostile was a Stray archer, spotted ahead at the start. I sprinted toward it, but it kept backing off while firing.
- Each arrow volley removed roughly two hearts, and my health dropped from full to one heart across five exchanges before the shield went up.
- None of my sword swings landed from what I could see. The Stray stayed two to four blocks away the entire fight.

Input problems observed:
- Camera turns were inconsistent. A -120 dx moved the view only slightly, while -300 overshot far past the target, so I repeatedly ended up aiming off to one side.
- Because of the aiming overshoot I wasted several actions re-centering instead of closing distance, and I raised the shield too late.
